classes.name: QuicStreamFactoryPeer

methods.name: GetConfig

methods.description: Retrieves the QuicCryptoClientConfigHandle for the specified factory and network anonymization key.

methods.name: HasActiveSession
methods.description: Checks if there is an active session for the given server ID and network key.

methods.name: HasActiveJob
methods.description: Checks if there is an active job for the specified server ID.

methods.name: GetPendingSession
methods.description: Returns the pending QuicChromiumClientSession for the specified server ID and destination.

methods.name: GetActiveSession
methods.description: Returns the active QuicChromiumClientSession for the specified server ID and network key.

methods.description: Determines if there is a live session for the given destination and server ID.

methods.description: Checks if the provided session is currently live.
